## Tsinghua University manuscript

The strip and character crops in `tsinghua/` derive from:

> Lǐ Xuéqín 李學勤, ed. (2010), *Qīnghuá dàxué cáng zhànguó zhújiǎn (yī)*
> 清華大學藏戰國竹簡（壹）.

Permission was obtained to publish these derived manuscript images as part
of this dataset. The underlying source edition and manuscript images remain
the property of their respective rights holders; this dataset does not assert
ownership of them or grant a general licence to redistribute, modify, or
republish the images independently. The source PDF and uncropped plates are
not included.

When referring to or displaying these images, cite the source edition and
this dataset.

## Reuse

The permission recorded for this release establishes that these crops may be
published as part of the dataset. Users who wish to reuse manuscript images
beyond quotation, citation, or use of this dataset should obtain any
permission required from the respective rights holder.

The bibliographic record for the source edition is in `../docs/sources.bib`.
